name: print-social-barbie-cutout-post-with-blue-banners-and-comment-card
title: Peach grain post with blue banner question, starbursts, a pink-dressed cutout and a white comment card
whatItIs: A grainy peach post with two slanted blue banners with cream caps, a pink starburst with an arrow, large lilac starbursts at the edges, a cutout of a winking woman in a pink gingham top and a white card with a yellow top edge, a heart icon and text inviting comments.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and interactive; the comment card turns the post into a game.
techniques: Use slanted blue banners for the question.
End with a white interaction card with a coloured edge.

vocabulary.definition: A spiky shape used as decoration.
A title strip with angled ends.
A cutout of a recognisable person.
